title: A Portrait for the Will
author: Noor Coldharbour
blurb: Noor Winterbourne, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
